page_title: PAL 3-0 VIL | Las Palmas v Villarreal 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Javier Iglesias Villanueva is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
90+2' The game is interrupted. Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
89' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
86' Here is a change. Munir El Haddadi is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Inaki Gonzalez (Las Palmas).
86' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kirian Rodriguez.
85' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing. Villarreal get a corner.

84' Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' The flag is raised and Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is offside again, not for the first time today.
75' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Alex Baena is replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Javier Munoz as he is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
73' Substitution. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) replaces Sandro Ramirez.

72' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Iglesias Villanueva with no other option than to blow for a foul.
68' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) replaces Santi Comesana.
68' It is time for a substitution. Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is on for Alfonso Pedraza.
66' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
66' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

66' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alvaro Valles pulls off a brilliant save. Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

63' 3 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
63' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marvin (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Alberto Moleiro cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) commits a foul and Javier Iglesias Villanueva immediately signals a free kick.

60' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles was alert and the score remained the same.
58' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
57' Surely that's handball by one of the Villarreal players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
56' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Jose Luis Morales will be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adria Altimira trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kiko (Villarreal).
53' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 2:0.
51' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner.
50' The ball is cleared after Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Las Palmas have a corner.
50' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' A quickly taken corner by Las Palmas.
48' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres over the bar.
43' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle. Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' It must be a yellow card. It is. Eric Bailly (Villarreal) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
38' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Javier Iglesias Villanueva didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Alex Baena (Villarreal) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance.
32' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
29' A corner kick by Villarreal is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
29' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
28' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Iglesias Villanueva no option but to blow his whistle.
24' This shall not pass! Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
21' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
20' The referee blows his whistle as Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
19' Alex Baena (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
16' The game has begun to heat up. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
16' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
13' Flag goes up against Santi Comesana (Villarreal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' 1 - 0 Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) gets on the scoresheet! He latched on to a precise pass and coolly slotted the ball into the top left corner.

6' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
4' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
1' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Adria Altimira (Villarreal) is given a yellow card.
1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and makes a call.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
